entry.title: New: Resolution 287 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
URGES THE OFFICE OF THE MAYOR TO REQUIRE THAT ALL BOARD AND COMMISSION MEETINGS PROVIDE VIRTUAL ACCESS FOR PUBLIC PARTICIPATION, LIVE VIEWING, AND POST-MEETING VIEWING

Seeks to ensure maximum levels of involvement, transparency, and accountability of government activity.
